name: nhs-ae-four-hour-decline

source.publisher: NHS England, A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions statistical work area
source.requests_note: 102 monthly provider-level CSV GETs plus 12 year-page GETs to enumerate the URLs; measured ~1 s wall clock on the coordinator (1.9 GiB class host)
source.fetch_provenance: v2026.11 fetched over HTTP on the coordinator. The publisher's CDN (CloudFront) serves HTTP 202 with an empty body to datacenter IPs (measured 2026-10-21 on worker job nhsae-001), so a worker cannot fetch this publisher; the v2026.10 build consumed the same bytes from staging release source-nhsae-001 (asset 661561799, sha256 8d8bc1b1..., verified per-file by build.py)

label.within4h_rate: 1 - Attendances over 4hrs Type 1 / A&E attendances Type 1
label.note: fixed thresholds measured near-uniform rates and were refused (record: <95% -> holdout 99.9% positive; <80% -> 95.8%); the m/m direction label is threshold-free

volume_gate.applies_to: the provider's qualifying months at or before M; the target month M+1 supplies only the label

revision_policy: duplicate (org, month) keys keep the copy from the latest upload, ordered by (revision datestamp in filename, revised flag, filename); originals without a datestamp sort before every revision

gate.note: eligibility counts a provider's volume-gated months at or before M, so the >=24-month history test can no longer see months after the feature month (the hindsight selection the 2026-10-21 audit found in v2026.10)

clustered_events_note: distinct_events counts distinct positive Org Codes per window - positives cluster within providers, so this is the conservative independent-unit count
schema_evolution: 16 data columns 2018-04..2020-07 (with 'Number of' prefixes in 2018-19); booked-appointment columns from 2020-08 (22 columns); unnamed padding columns from 2024-09 (28 header fields); booked columns parsed but not shipped - they are absent for train feature months 2018-12..2020-07, so shipping them would be a split-dependent prediction-timing defect

reference_baselines.note: stdlib rank AUC measured at construction on the written rows; every score is a prediction-time-safe single feature

runner_contract_baseline.note: measured via baseline/reproduce_baseline.sh on the rebuilt public splits, coordinator, after gate 1.4.0 passed on the full artifact; below every eval reference (target-month prior 0.6027, reversal 0.5839, persistence 0.5758, mean reversion 0.5659). The v2026.10 worker baseline nhsae-baseline-001 (0.5526 on superseded artifact 9903df974f233dfa) is preserved in the candidate record and in staging release 419227918.
